title.en: Name the Xingtai Product Path, Not a Nickname
title.zh: 询盘写邢台的产品路径，不要写昵称

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai quotes a path such as /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/. A nickname like “the big 50” matches more than one sheet.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台按路径报价，例如 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/。“大 50”这类昵称会对应到不止一张表。

h1.en: The Order Starts with the Product Path

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai can see which sheet you read only if the inquiry contains the path. Use [/en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/](/en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/) or the Chinese path, not “50-type”. Shared strings such as HBT80-1816-110 and HBT60-13.132 still need the path beside them. Send that line to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
directAnswer.zh: 只有询盘里有路径，河北品锦机械（邢台）才看得出你读的是哪一张表。请写 [/zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/) 或英文路径，不要写“50型”。HBT80-1816-110 和 HBT60-13.132 这类共享字符串旁边仍然要有路径。把这一行发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

body.en: Electric, diesel and mixer hubs are [/en/products/electric-concrete-pumps/](/en/products/electric-concrete-pumps/), [/en/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/](/en/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/) and [/en/products/mixer-pumps/](/en/products/mixer-pumps/). A model path sits under those hubs. A project nickname is not a path.
body.zh: 电动、柴油和搅拌泵分类是 [/zh/products/electric-concrete-pumps/](/zh/products/electric-concrete-pumps/)、[/zh/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/](/zh/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/) 和 [/zh/products/mixer-pumps/](/zh/products/mixer-pumps/)。型号路径在这些分类下面。项目昵称不是路径。

body.en: You may list two paths and ask which one Xingtai should price. You may not merge them into a third name the catalogue does not have.
body.zh: 你可以列出两条路径，请邢台报其中一条。不能把它们合成目录里没有的第三个名称。

body.en: The site configuration lists PinjinHebei@Outlook.com and 19912003025, plus the contact page and the on-site WhatsApp button. Put the path in the first line.
body.zh: 站点配置列出 PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 和 19912003025，以及询盘页和站内 WhatsApp。第一行写路径。

question.en: Is the Chinese path a different machine?
question.zh: 中文路径是另一台机器吗？

answer.en: No. /zh/products/ and /en/products/ with the same slug are the two languages of one page.
answer.zh: 不是。相同型号地址的 /zh/products/ 和 /en/products/ 是同一页的两种语言。

question.en: Can I send only the HBT code?
question.zh: 只发 HBT 代码可以吗？

answer.en: Add the path. Two pages can share one code.
answer.zh: 请加上路径。两页可以共享一个代码。

question.en: What if I have not chosen?

answer.en: Send the two candidate paths and the site facts. Do not invent a slug.
answer.zh: 发送两条候选路径和现场事实。不要编造型号地址。

question.en: Does the path include a price?

answer.en: No. The path identifies the sheet. The price is confirmed by inquiry.
answer.zh: 不包含。路径用来识别参数表。价格由询盘确认。
